summary: Stream command parser with slot-table lookup. Reads a variable-length command (2-byte size header, slot count, per-slot id/parameter pairs, and a trailer) from a refillable byte stream, validates the size against the slot count, looks up each slot id in a 21-dword table at this+0xC4, publishes the parsed values and state codes to the dispatcher object, and returns 1 on a fully parsed command. Called from CommandDispatchStateMachine.

operations.description: Load the stream read state: v1 = a1[5] (this+0x14); capture the current read pointer v1[0] and the remaining-byte count v1[1].
Guard on this+0x1E1 (a1[100]+81): when zero, write state 61 to obj+0x14 and dispatch through the obj vtable entry 0.
Refill guard: whenever the remaining count reaches zero before the next byte is read, call the stream refill callback v1[3](a1); if it returns zero the parser aborts and returns 0.
Parse the 2-byte size header: the first byte contributes the high half and the second byte is added to it, producing the message length in v27.
Parse the slot count from the third header byte into v22.
Validation guard: when v27 != 2 * v22 + 6 or v22 < 1 or v22 > 4, write state 9 to obj+0x14 and dispatch through the obj vtable entry 0.
Start per-slot processing: write state 102 to obj+0x14, store the slot count to obj+0x18, dispatch via the obj vtable entry 1, and record the count at this+0x120.

Loop v22 times over the slots: for each, read the slot id byte (refilling the stream as needed) and linearly search the 21-dword slot table rooted at this+0xC4 for an entry whose first dword equals the slot id.
Table-size guard: when this+0x20 is zero or negative the search is skipped to an error path writing state 5 and the slot id to obj+0x18, then dispatching through the obj vtable entry 0.
On a table match, store the found entry pointer into this+0x124 (indexed by slot position) and decompose the per-slot parameter byte into two nibbles stored in entry dwords 5 (high) and 6 (low).
Publish the slot values to the dispatcher object: obj+0x18 = slot id, obj+0x1C = nibble high, obj+0x20 = nibble low; set state 103 and dispatch via the obj vtable entry 1.
Parse the trailer: read bytes into this+0x168 and this+0x16C, and the high/low nibbles of the third trailer byte into this+0x170 and this+0x174.
Publish the trailer to the dispatcher object: obj+0x18 through obj+0x24 receive the four trailer-derived values; set state 104 and dispatch via the obj vtable entry 1.
Reset the completion flag at this+0x1E4 (a1[100]+84) to 0 and increment the command counter at this+0x7C.
Finalize the stream state: set v1[0] = v16 + 1 (new read pointer) and v1[1] = v35 - 1 (new remaining count).
Return 1 on a fully parsed and dispatched command; return 0 when any stream refill fails mid-parse. Invoked from CommandDispatchStateMachine.
